tests.name: flatten_deep_array
tests.intent: Verify that flattening a deeply nested array of 500 levels succeeds without stack overflow and produces the correct single path and value.

tests.name: flatten_deep_object
tests.intent: Verify that flattening a deeply nested object of 500 levels succeeds and yields the expected escaped path.

tests.name: flatten_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify that flattening an empty array at the root maps to null with an empty pointer path.

tests.name: flatten_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify that flattening an empty object at the root maps to null with an empty pointer path.

tests.name: flatten_escaped_keys
tests.intent: Verify that keys containing special characters like '~' and '/' are properly escaped in the flattened reference strings.

tests.name: flatten_ordered_json_order
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json preserves the iteration and entry order after flattening.

tests.name: flatten_primitives
tests.intent: Verify flattening non-container primitive values directly at the root.

tests.name: flatten_mixed_nested
tests.intent: Verify flattening of an alternating nested structure of arrays and objects.

tests.name: flatten_empty_containers_nested
tests.intent: Verify that empty arrays or objects nested inside larger structures flatten to null values at their correct paths.

tests.name: flatten_null_and_bool_values
tests.intent: Verify flattening structures containing boolean and null leaves alongside numbers and strings.

tests.name: flatten_unflatten_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verify that flattening and then unflattening a complex structured JSON restores the original value identically.

tests.name: flatten_binary_type
tests.intent: Verify flattening values that contain binary subtype data.

tests.name: json_pointer_construction_and_stringification
tests.intent: Verify basic pointer string parsing, construction, and conversion back to string.

tests.name: json_pointer_concat_operators
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer operator/ composition with strings, indices, and other pointers.

tests.name: json_pointer_comparisons
tests.intent: Verify equality and less-than relational operators on json_pointer instances.

tests.name: json_pointer_streaming_operator
tests.intent: Verify output stream operator behavior for json_pointer.

tests.name: flatten_single_element_array
tests.intent: Verify flattening an array containing a single primitive element.

tests.name: flatten_single_element_object
tests.intent: Verify flattening an object containing a single key-value pair.

tests.name: flatten_wide_object
tests.intent: Verify flattening an object with many flat children properties.

tests.name: flatten_wide_array
tests.intent: Verify flattening a wide array with many indices.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Verify that flattening a non-empty object exercises the object_const_iterator frame instantiation, stack frame struct members, container member pointer, and the else branch of the container type check.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Verify flattening a nested object structure to trigger stack frames with object_const_iterator pushing, path_length tracking, index initialization, and iterating through multiple object members.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Verify flattening a mixed structure of an object containing an array, ensuring both the object branch and the array branch interact properly via the stack frame structure and iterators.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Verify flattening using ordered_json with an object to ensure object_const_iterator and frame construction work correctly with iteration-order-preserving containers.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Verify flattening an object whose keys require pointer escaping and have multiple nested fields to fully exercise frame path_length restoration, member traversal, and the object else branch path.
